messages.content:
You are a typical viewer scrolling TikTok at night. You have NEVER seen this show and know nothing about its story or characters.
You will read several short clips. For each clip you get exactly what plays: spoken lines and what is on screen, with times in seconds from the first frame of THAT clip (0.0 = the moment it appears in your feed). [CUT] marks a jump to a later moment.
Judge each clip ON ITS OWN, as if it were the only one you ever saw. Never use information from one clip to understand another.
Be a harsh, honest judge. Most clips are mediocre. Reserve 5 for truly scroll-stopping work.
Scores (1-5):
- hook: would 0-3 s make you stop scrolling? Judge only what happens in 0.0-3.0 s.
- standalone: could you follow who is who and what is at stake without knowing the show?
- cliffhanger: does it cut at an unresolved moment that makes you NEED the next part? 1 if it resolves or ends flat.
- tap_to_watch: overall, would you tap through to watch the show?
Return JSON only.

=== CLIP A (52.0 s) ===
[0.0-2.2] SCREEN: Medium shot as Juliana stops midway down the aisle, confronted by a haughty matriarch in black velvet stepping into the foreground.
[0.3-2.1] MATRIARCH (Cold, Commanding): "You should turn around, Juliana."
[2.5-3.3] LADY JULIANA (Confused, Breathless): "Why?"
[3.3-6.8] SCREEN: Over-the-shoulder medium close-up past the Matriarch to Juliana, looking past her toward the altar.
[4.5-6.5] LADY JULIANA (Desperate, Unbelieving): "Gerald is waiting for me."
[6.8-9.5] SCREEN: Close-up on the Matriarch wearing an ornate tiara and sapphire jewelry, gazing down with merciless disdain.
[7.0-8.4] MATRIARCH (Blunt, Unforgiving): "Not anymore."
[9.5-12.6] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's stricken face as the weight of the words sinks in.
[10.8-12.5] LADY JULIANA (Trembling, Pleading): "What do you mean?"
[12.6-14.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Matriarch gesturing dismissively toward the altar.
[12.8-14.5] MATRIARCH (Dismissive): "Look for yourself."
[14.6-18.8] ACTION: Juliana walks forward past the Matriarch, her breath hitching as she approaches the altar steps, looking up in shock.
[14.8-18.8] SCREEN: Medium front tracking shot moving backward ahead of Juliana as she advances down the center aisle.
[18.8-21.8] SCREEN: Panning shot across the seated wedding guests whispering and casting judging glances from the wooden pews.
[21.8-22.7] SCREEN: Low-angle shot from behind Juliana looking up at Gerald and the Lady in Gold Gown standing proudly before the altar.
[22.7-24.3] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's trembling lips and shocked, tearful blue eyes.
[22.8-24.0] LADY JULIANA (Shaken, Whispering): "Gerald?"
[24.4-26.7] LADY JULIANA (Heartbroken): "Why are you holding her hand?"
[25.5-28.0] SCREEN: Close-up insert of Gerald's fingers firmly interlocked with the white-gloved hand of the Lady in Gold Gown.
[28.0-30.5] SCREEN: Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown beaming with cruel triumph.
[28.1-30.2] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Gloating, Smug): "Because he is marrying me."
[30.5-32.9] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana as tears spill over her eyelashes.
[30.7-32.1] LADY JULIANA (Gasping, Devastated): "No..."
[32.9-35.8] SCREEN: Wide profile shot showing Juliana standing below the altar platform, looking up at Gerald and her sister.
[35.8-39.4] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana clutching her chest, her sorrow turning into burning outrage.
[35.8-39.0] LADY JULIANA (Outraged, Accusing): "You knew this before I walked through those doors!"
[39.4-41.0] SCREEN: Medium shot of Gerald standing stoic and impassive next to the smug Lady in Gold Gown.
[41.0-43.6] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's hands desperately clenching fistfuls of her white dress fabric.
[41.8-43.6] LADY JULIANA (Choking on Tears): "You let me come here..."
[43.6-46.6] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she shakes with grief.
[43.7-45.9] LADY JULIANA (Crushed, Shaking): "You let me dress in my mother's gown..."
[46.0-49.0] LADY JULIANA (Crying Out): "You let me believe I was walking toward my husband!"
[46.6-49.1] SCREEN: Medium shot on Gerald stepping forward, cold and indifferent, with the Lady in Gold Gown lingering in soft focus behind him.
[49.1-52.0] SCREEN: Tight close-up on Gerald's hardened profile as he glances down.
[49.1-50.8] THE FORMER GROOM (Cold, Callous): "I changed my mind."

=== CLIP B (38.0 s) ===
[0.0-3.5] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Cruel, Poised): "Long enough to know he was never going to marry you."
[4.0-6.0] ACTION: Juliana turns abruptly toward the first row of pews, where her elderly father sits gripping an ornate brass cane.
[4.0-6.4] SCREEN: Close-up on the father's hand tightly gripping the gold curved handle of his walking cane.
[5.1-6.2] LADY JULIANA (Desperate): "Father..."
[6.4-8.7] SCREEN: Wide shot showing Juliana dropping to her knees beside her seated father, pleading with him.
[6.4-8.6] LADY JULIANA (Begging): "Tell them this is a mistake."
[8.7-11.0] SCREEN: Close-up on the father's weathered face, looking fixedly at the floor, refusing to meet her gaze.
[11.0-14.5] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana looking up at him, tears streaming uncontrollably down her cheeks.
[11.0-13.9] LADY JULIANA (Choking, Broken): "Father... please look at me."
[14.5-15.8] ACTION: The father tightens his jaw and stony expression, refusing to offer a single word or look.
[14.5-15.8] SCREEN: Profile close-up of the father staring blankly forward.
[15.8-20.8] SCREEN: Low-angle shot looking up at the Matriarch commanding the space with regal severity.
[15.9-16.9] MATRIARCH (Stern, Resolute): "Enough!"
[17.1-20.5] MATRIARCH (Disgusted): "You have embarrassed this family long enough."
[20.8-23.6] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana as she rises, stung by the utter betrayal.
[21.2-23.2] LADY JULIANA (Incredulous): "Embarrassed you?"
[23.6-27.5] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Matriarch gesturing toward Clarissa, who stands elegantly in gold.
[23.8-26.5] MATRIARCH (Haughty): "Clarissa knows how to carry herself."
[26.6-30.0] MATRIARCH (Proud): "She has beauty, connections, and a future worth protecting."
[27.5-30.3] SCREEN: Medium profile two-shot of the Matriarch confronting Juliana face to face.
[30.3-32.4] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana, demanding answers in spite of her humiliation.
[30.4-32.3] LADY JULIANA (Raw, Painful): "And I am what?"
[32.4-35.0] SCREEN: Medium tracking shot showing the Lady in Gold Gown stepping past Juliana toward the center.
[32.5-35.8] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Viciously Calm): "You are the daughter people tolerate because they have to."
[35.0-38.0] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana absorbing the venomous words, her breathing shallow.
[36.1-38.0] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Gloating): "I am the daughter they choose."
